title: Change a value through a subroutine
summary: Fortran: Change a value through a subroutine. Start n at 7.
introduction: A subroutine is called with call. intent(inout) means this input may be changed.
learningObjectives: Change a value through a subroutine with Fortran

blocks.text: Install GNU Fortran. Save each example as lesson.f90, run gfortran -std=f2008 lesson.f90 -o lesson, then run it.
Change a value through a subroutine

blocks.title: Change a value through a subroutine
blocks.code:
program lesson
 implicit none
 integer :: n = 4
 call double_value(n)
 write(*,'(I0)') n
contains
 subroutine double_value(value)
  integer, intent(inout) :: value
  value = value * 2
 end subroutine double_value
end program lesson

blocks.text: call passes n as an inout value. The subroutine changes the original to 8.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use call for a subroutine; a function is used in an expression.
